input: 204 small-variant records on chromosome 21 selected from a pool of 1,750 candidates: the chromosome 21 records of the committed GRCh38 golden corpora, a sample of the clinically associated variants and a sample of the common variants of Ensembl release 116's chromosome 21 variation set, without symbolic or breakend alleles and without any record Ensembl VEP's --everything co-locates with a COSMIC or HGMD-PUBLIC identifier; one exemplar per consequence-set combination the pool shows under --everything, stratified by variant class, strand and the presence of the frequency, clinical and identifier columns the family columns name; the records inside a regulatory feature or a transcription-factor binding motif carry RegulatoryFeature or MotifFeature rows in the reference, compared like every other row against the regulatory tree of the pruned cache
generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags, then scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite everything=<reference>=<candidates> --k 1 --seed 1 --cache <converted slice> --flank 5000 --covers everything --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --family-columns MAX_AF,AF,CLIN_SIG,PUBMED,SOMATIC,miRNA,GENE_PHENO,DOMAINS,SIFT,MANE_PLUS_CLINICAL --flag=--everything; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --regulatory --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts whose rows carry SIFT or PolyPhen> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 --variations <cache> --exclude-variation '^COSV\d' --exclude-variation '^(C[A-Z]|BM|HM)\d{6}' over chromosome 21 of the converted release 116 GRCh38 cache with its regulatory tree (protein features kept on every transcript, prediction matrices on the 359 transcripts that print SIFT or PolyPhen, the regulatory shards as activity codes over the cache's cell-type list, the binding matrices in one table), its info.json carried through; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify --field HIGH_INF_POS --field MOTIF_SCORE_CHANGE over the whole reference, its RegulatoryFeature and MotifFeature rows included

variation_slice.source: homo_sapiens/116_GRCh38/21/all_vars.gz of the Ensembl VEP release-116 indexed cache
variation_slice.window: records whose start lies within one base of an input record's span
variation_slice.slice_check: the golden comparison: vep-rs on this slice writes the Existing_variation, frequency, CLIN_SIG, PHENO and PUBMED values Ensembl VEP 116.2 wrote on the full cache for every record

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with
